scenarios.name: 230 - Custom Assignment Rules - Matching Assign Rule Wins And Flags ruleOverride
scenarios.description: An assign rule whose condition matches sets the variant; the exposure is flagged ruleOverride:true with assigned:false (the backend excludes it from analysis), not custom. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 231 - Custom Assignment Rules - Non-Matching Assign Rule Falls Through To Normal Assignment
scenarios.description: An assign rule whose condition does not match is skipped and the unit takes its ordinary assignment (variant 1 here, assigned:true, ruleOverride:false). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 232 - Custom Assignment Rules - Out-Of-Range Rule Variant Is Ignored And Later Rules Are Not Tried
scenarios.description: The first matching rule's variant (5) is out of range for a two-variant experiment, so normal assignment applies and the second rule (variant 0) is NOT tried: the unit gets its ordinary assignment (variant 1), not variant 0. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 233 - Custom Assignment Rules - Split Rule Randomizes Over Its Own Percentages And Flags ruleOverride
scenarios.description: A split rule with percentages 0/100 sends every unit to variant 1 over the rule's own percentages; the exposure is flagged ruleOverride:true, assigned:false. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 234 - Custom Assignment Rules - Environment-Scoped Rule Does Not Match A Different Environment
scenarios.description: A rule scoped to environment 'production' does not match the reference context's environment, so it is skipped and the unit takes its ordinary assignment (variant 1). 'production' is used because it matches no SDK wrapper's environment name. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 235 - Custom Assignment Rules - Override Beats A Matching Rule
scenarios.description: setOverride wins over every rule: with a rule that would assign variant 1, an override to variant 2 gives variant 2 with overridden:true (ruleOverride:false, assigned:false). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 236 - Custom Assignment Rules - Rule Takes Precedence Over A Strict Audience Mismatch
scenarios.description: A matching rule is evaluated before audience targeting: even though the strict audience (tier == gold) does not match, the rule assigns variant 1 with ruleOverride:true and audienceMismatch:false (audience is not evaluated for a rule win). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 237 - Custom Assignment Rules - Rule Takes Precedence Over A Custom Assignment
scenarios.description: A matching rule wins over a custom assignment: customAssignment(2) is set, but the rule assigns variant 1 with ruleOverride:true (custom:false). The custom assignment only shows when no rule matches. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 238 - Custom Assignment Rules - Variable Value Is Served Through A Rule Win
scenarios.description: variableValue resolves through a rule-won assignment (assigned:false but ruleOverride): the rule assigns variant 1, so variableValue('color') returns variant 1's 'blue' and queues the rule-flagged exposure. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 239 - Custom Assignment Rules - Rule Variant Of A Removed Experiment Is Rebuilt, Not Served Stale
scenarios.description: javascript-sdk#67 edge case: a rule assigns variant 1 (ruleOverride:true). After a refresh whose data no longer contains the experiment, the cached rule variant is dropped and the experiment is rebuilt to variant 0 (assigned:false, ruleOverride:false) with a fresh exposure, instead of serving the stale rule variant. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 240 - Semver Operators - semver_gte Matches (1.5.0 vs 1.2.0)
scenarios.description: Strict audience uses semver_gte; with app_version='1.5.0' the filter matches (1.5.0 >= 1.2.0 is true), so the unit gets variant 1 (assigned). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 241 - Semver Operators - semver_gte Does Not Match (1.1.0 vs 1.2.0)
scenarios.description: Strict audience uses semver_gte; with app_version='1.1.0' the filter does not match (1.1.0 >= 1.2.0 is false), so the unit gets variant 0 with audienceMismatch:true. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 242 - Semver Operators - semver_eq Matches (v1.2 vs 1.2.0+build)
scenarios.description: Strict audience uses semver_eq; with app_version='v1.2' the filter matches (v1.2 == 1.2.0+build: leading v and +build metadata are ignored, missing patch is 0), so the unit gets variant 1 (assigned). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 243 - Semver Operators - semver_gt Matches (1.10.0 vs 1.9.0)
scenarios.description: Strict audience uses semver_gt; with app_version='1.10.0' the filter matches (1.10.0 > 1.9.0: numeric identifiers compare numerically, not lexicographically), so the unit gets variant 1 (assigned). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 244 - Semver Operators - semver_lt Matches (1.0.0-beta vs 1.0.0)
scenarios.description: Strict audience uses semver_lt; with app_version='1.0.0-beta' the filter matches (1.0.0-beta < 1.0.0: a pre-release ranks below its release), so the unit gets variant 1 (assigned). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 245 - Semver Operators - semver_lte Matches (2.0.0 vs 2.0.0)
scenarios.description: Strict audience uses semver_lte; with app_version='2.0.0' the filter matches (2.0.0 <= 2.0.0 is true), so the unit gets variant 1 (assigned). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 246 - Audience Re-Evaluation - Setting An Attribute That Satisfies A Strict Audience Reassigns And Re-Exposes
scenarios.description: A strict audience (tier == gold) is unmatched at first, so treatment is variant 0 with audienceMismatch:true. Setting tier=gold re-evaluates the audience on the next treatment: the unit now matches, is assigned variant 1, and a fresh exposure is queued (pending grows). Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).

scenarios.name: 247 - Audience Re-Evaluation - Setting An Attribute That Breaks A Strict Audience Reassigns To Control
scenarios.description: The mirror case: tier=gold matches first (variant 1, assigned). Setting tier=silver re-evaluates the audience on the next treatment: the unit no longer matches, is reassigned variant 0 with audienceMismatch:true, and a fresh exposure is queued. Expected results recorded from @absmartly/javascript-sdk 1.14.0 (javascript-sdk#67).
